name: MatAnyone
plain: MatAnyone (Yang et al., S-Lab NTU, CVPR 2025): video matting of one object: from a mask of the object in the first frame it tracks the object and outputs a soft alpha matte (hair, motion blur) for every frame, with a memory of earlier frames. Non-commercial code and weights (S-Lab License 1.0).
summary: MatAnyone (Yang et al., NTU S-Lab, CVPR 2025): video matting of one object from a mask on the first frame. A Cutie-style memory network (ResNet-50 frame encoder, ResNet-18 mask encoder, object transformer) reads the alpha and features of earlier frames with consistent memory propagation: each region updates its memory only where the alpha changes. Takes a video and the first-frame mask (`video`); a single image is a one-frame video.

papers.title: MatAnyone: Stable Video Matting with Consistent Memory Propagation

no_kernels_reason: not implemented: ResNet encoders plus a memory readout and small object transformer per frame; portable runs 1.2 % faster than the original fp16 at 1080x1920 (1205 vs 1220 ms) with 9 % lower peak allocated memory (2719 vs 2978 MB) and identical task accuracy (YouTubeMatte MAD 2.636 both); against the original fp32 at 512x288 portable fp16 is 5 % slower per frame (20.5 vs 19.4 ms) with 24 % less memory, so the speed bar holds at 1080p and against fp16 only
task_io: Input: one RGB image (trimap-guided models also a trimap: background / unknown / foreground). Output: an alpha matte `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size: 1 = foreground (background removal, dichotomous / salient object segmentation).

variants.name: matanyone

licence.training_note: doc/TRAIN.md: matting on VM800 (not released) and ImageMatte (Distinctions-646 + Adobe Image Matting), backgrounds from BG-20k and DVM, segmentation on COCO, YouTube-VIS 2021 and Supervisely Person.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); pq-yang/MatAnyone@e5ddc534c1ff process_video loop on frames in memory, cv2 mask closing

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: YouTubeMatte 512 x 288, every 2nd clip (32 x 100 frames), first-frame mask, MAD x 1000 / MSE x 1000 / dtSSD x 100
quality.protocol: Video matting, YouTubeMatte (MatAnyone's benchmark): each clip at 512 x 288 with the authors' first-frame mask, the authors' evaluation settings (1 warm-up step, mask closing 4 px); 8-bit alpha against the ground truth: mean absolute and squared difference and the temporal coherence error dtSSD (lower is better), averaged over frames, then clips.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-06 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 8.3e-05 and p99 <= 0.0001 (absolute error of the output `alpha`).
